Riley (Marketing): Quick ask: we need a reproducible bench bundle for launch comms. Goals: compare fp16 vs int8 quant, warmup vs coldstart, and provide p50/p95 + cost deltas. Workloads: single-turn gen (~1k), long chat (16k), embeddings. Need 50 sample outputs for QA. Deadline: EOD Fri.

Priya (Runtime): Got it. Clarify models and batches? Want streaming traces for generation?

Riley (Marketing): Use redwood-3-small and redwood-3-medium. Batches 1,8,32. Streaming for gen yes. Embeds no. Warmup policy: 2 warmup requests per instance, 100k warmup tokens. Coldstart=0 warmup.

Jordan (Eng Runtime): I'll run canary on small first and cap concurrency to avoid noise. Please upload payloads and seeds.

Riley (Marketing): Uploaded payloads: https://redwood.internal/samples/launch50.json seeds: https://redwood.internal/seeds/launch-6185.txt

Priya (Runtime): Run plan: canary -> smoke -> full sweep. Command snippet posted to artifacts. We'll attach raw traces, aggregated percentiles, cost estimates per 1M tokens, and sample outputs. If resources limit, we'll skip medium+batch32 for 16k and note it.

bench-bot: Job queued: bench-6185000000-canary (ETA ~2h).

Jordan (Eng Runtime): Canary started on node small-a. Posting early p50/p95 when ready.

bench-bot: bench-6185000000-canary logs: https://bench-logs/6185000000/canary

Priya (Runtime): Canary done. Early: small fp16 gen p95 ~110ms stream, int8 ~128ms; embed p95 ~42ms. Uploading gist and samples: https://bench-artifacts/6185000000/canary-gist

Riley (Marketing): Thanks! We'll draft slides off the canary and wait for full artifact bundle. Please flag any int8 quality regressions.
